name: Cone Discrete Sampling
definition: To alleviate aliasing, a ray is defined as a cone considering pixel size. A conical frustum is represented by eight vertices. Features of any 3D sampled position x within the frustum are blended from the vertices x_v using decreasing weights based on distance.
summary: Cone Discrete Sampling is a volume rendering technique that alleviates aliasing by discretizing a camera pixel's cone into frustums and blending vertex features using distance-dependent weights.
